title: GPSeq reveals the radial organization of chromatin in the cell nucleus
protocol: Wash the cells with 1X PBS containing Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ pre-warmed to 37 °C.
Incubate for 2 min at room temperature (RT).
Aspirate the PBS solution from the dish.
Add 0.4X PBS with Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ at RT.
Incubate for 1 min at RT.
Aspirate the PBS solution.
Add 0.4X PBS/4% PFA at RT.
Incubate for 10 min at RT.
Aspirate the fixative solution from the dish.
Quench the residual PFA by adding 1X PBS/125 mM glycine.
Incubate for 5 min at RT.
Briefly wash the cells in 1X PBS at RT.
Wash the cells in 1X PBS/0.05% Triton X-100 three times, 5 min each at RT, while shaking.
Aspirate the PBS solution and then add 1X PBS/0.5% Triton X-100 at RT.
Incubate for 20 min at RT.
Briefly wash the cells in 1X PBS at room temperature.
Briefly wash the cells in 1X PBS/20% glycerol at room temperature.
Incubate the samples in 1X PBS/20% glycerol for 18 hours at room temperature.
Fill a cryo-resistant Dewar flask with liquid N₂.
Remove the glycerol solution from the dish (leave a thin layer on top of the cells).
Place the dish on the surface of liquid N₂ for 20–30 seconds.
Place the dish at room temperature and let the samples thaw gradually, making sure that they do not dry.
Once all the samples are thawed, fill the dish with fresh 1X PBS/20% glycerol at room temperature.
Incubate for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Repeat steps removing glycerol solution, placing on liquid N₂, thawing gradually, and incubating in PBS/glycerol four times.
Wash the samples in 1X PBS/0.05% Triton X-100 two times, 5 minutes each at room temperature, while shaking.
Briefly rinse the samples in 0.1 M HCl at room temperature.
Incubate the samples in 0.1 M HCl for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Briefly rinse the samples in 1X PBS/0.05% Triton X-100 at room temperature.
Wash the samples in 1X PBS/0.05% Triton X-100 two times, 5 minutes each at room temperature, while shaking.
Wash the samples for 5 minutes in 2X SSC.
Place coverslips in a 10 cm dish, cover them with 5 ml of the PLL solution, and then gently shake the dishes for 15 min at RT.
Aspirate the solution and transfer it into a 15 ml tube.
Wash the coverslips three times with 1X PBS at RT and once with ethanol (EtOH) 70%.
Air-dry the coverslips and proceed with cell spotting and fixation.
Store washed coverslips in EtOH 70% at 4 °C if not used immediately, air-dry just before use.
Place the desired number of PLL-coated coverslips into a 6-well cell culture plate.
In each well, dispense a cell suspension freshly prepared in 1X PBS with Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺.
Let the cells sediment onto the coverslip for 10 min at room temperature.
Slowly add 0.4X PBS with Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ at room temperature.
Incubate for 1 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the PBS solution.
Slowly add 0.4X PBS/4% PFA at room temperature.
Incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the fixative solution from the dish.
Quench the residual PFA by adding 1X PBS/125 mM glycine.
Briefly wash the cells in 1X PBS at room temperature.
Wash the cells in 1X PBS/0.05% Triton X-100 three times, 5 min each at room temperature while shaking.
Aspirate the PBS solution and then add 1X PBS/0.5% Triton X-100 at room temperature.
Incubate for 20 min at room temperature.
Briefly wash the cells in 1X PBS at room temperature.
Briefly wash the cells in 1X PBS/20% glycerol at room temperature.
Incubate the samples in 1X PBS/20% glycerol for 18 h at room temperature.
Fill a cryo-resistant Dewar flask with liquid N₂.
Remove the glycerol solution from the dish (leave a thin layer on top of the cells).
Place the dish on the surface of liquid nitrogen for 20–30 sec.
Place the dish at room temperature and let the samples thaw gradually, making sure that they do not dry.
Once all the samples are thawed, fill the dish with fresh 1X PBS/20% glycerol at room temperature.
Incubate for 3 min at room temperature.
Repeat steps 20–23 four times.
Wash the samples in 1X PBS/0.05% Triton X-100 two times, 5 min each at room temperature, while shaking.
Briefly rinse the samples in 0.1 M HCl at room temperature.
Incubate the samples in 0.1 M HCl for 5 min at room temperature.
Briefly rinse the samples in 1X PBS/0.05% Triton X-100 at room temperature.
Wash the samples in 1X PBS/0.05% Triton X-100 two times, 5 min each at room temperature, while shaking.
Wash the samples for 5 min in 2X SSC.
Replace the solution to fresh 2X SSC and process the samples immediately or alternatively store them in 2X SSC/0.05% NaN3 for up to 1 month at 4 °C.
Bring the 2X SSC/50 mM phosphate buffer/50% FA (FPS) solution to room temperature.
Rinse the samples with FPS at room temperature.
Exchange to fresh FPS and store at room temperature protected from light for 20 h.
Wash the samples in 2X SSC for 5 min at room temperature.
Wash the samples in 1X CutSmart, two times, 5 min each at room temperature, while gently rocking.
Mix 40 μl of CutSmart buffer (10X) for the digestion mix.
Add HindIII-HF enzyme to the mixture as per protocol instructions.
Pre-warm the digestion mix for at least 10 min at 37 °C.
Dispense the digestion mix on a piece of Parafilm placed inside a humidity chamber.
Gently flip one sample at a time onto a droplet of the digestion mix.
Incubate each coverslip at 37 °C in the sealed humidity chamber for a selected period of time.
Stop the digestion by washing the samples with ice-cold 1X PBS/50 mM EDTA/0.01% Triton X-100 three times, 5 min each, on ice.
Rinse the samples with 1X CutSmart/0.01 % Triton X-100 at RT.
Wash with 1X CutSmart/0.01 % Triton X-100 for 5 min at RT.
Wash the samples in 1X Alkaline phosphatase (AP) buffer for 5 min at RT.
Mix 40 μl of AP buffer (10X).
Pipette 6 μl of AP (1 U/μl).
Add 354 μl of nuclease-free water.
Dispense the dephosphorylation mix on a piece of Parafilm placed inside a humidity chamber.
Gently flip one coverslip at a time onto a droplet of the dephosphorylation mix.
Incubate the samples for 2 h at 37 °C in the sealed humidity chamber.
Transfer the samples back to a 6-well plate.
Wash the samples with 1X CutSmart/0.01% Triton X-100 two times, 5 min each at RT.
Wash the samples in 1X T4 Ligase buffer two times, 5 min each at RT, while gently rocking.
Thaw all reagents slowly on ice or at 4 °C.
Mix 21 μl of ligation reaction buffer.
Add 24 μl of ATP (10 mM) to the mixture.
Add 6 μl of BSA (5 mg/ml).
Add 6 μl of HindIII GPSeq adapter (10 µM).
Alternatively, add 18 μl of MboI GPSeq adapter (10 µM).
Add up to 210 μl of nuclease-free water to reach the desired volume.
Dispense the ligation mix I on a piece of Parafilm placed inside a humidity chamber.
Gently flip one sample at a time onto the droplet of ligation mix I.
Incubate the samples for 30 min at room temperature.
Mix 45 μl of nuclease-free water.
Add 9 μl of ligase buffer (10X).
Pipette 36 μl of T4 Ligase enzyme.
Gently pipette the ligase mix II under each coverslip, in and out 7–8 times, making sure not to make bubbles.
Incubate the samples for 18 h at 16 °C in the sealed humidity chamber.
In a new 6-well plate, wash the samples in 1X HSW five times, 1 hour each at 37 °C, while shaking.
Wash the samples in 1X PBS three times, 5 min each at RT.
Equilibrate the samples in 2X SSC/25% FA.
Prepare the following hybridization mix for one 22x22 mm coverslip.
Mix 297 μl of YHB.
Add 3 μl of fluorescently labelled oligonucleotide at a concentration of 2 μM.
Dispense the hybridization mix on a piece of Parafilm inside a humidity chamber.
Gently flip one sample onto the droplet of hybridization mix.
Incubate the samples for 18 h at 30 °C inside the sealed humidity chamber.
Transfer the samples into a 6-well plate pre-filled with 2 ml/well of YWB pre-warmed at room temperature.
Exchange the YWB solution and incubate for 1 h at 30 °C, while gently shaking.
Remove the YWB solution and add 2 ml/well of YWB/0.1 ng/ml Hoechst 33342.
Incubate for 30 min at 30 °C, while gently shaking.
Quickly rinse the samples with 2X SSC.
Mount the samples and image them using wide-field microscopy or, if available, STED microscopy.
Wash the samples with nuclease-free water three times, 2 min each at room temperature.
Scrape each coverslip in the DNA extraction mix.
Add 100 μl of DEB to the mix.
Add 10 μl of Proteinase K (0.8 U/μl) to the mix.
Transfer each sample into a 1.5 ml Eppendorf® DNA LoBind tube.
Incubate the samples for 18 h at 56 °C while shaking at 800 rpm.
Inactivate the enzyme by incubating for 10 min at 96 °C.
Place the samples on ice.
Add an equal volume of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1) to each sample.
Shake the samples vigorously.
Centrifuge the samples at 20,000 x g for 5 min at room temperature.
Collect the upper phase and transfer it to a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf® DNA LoBind tube.
Add an equal volume of chloroform to the collected upper phase and shake vigorously.
Centrifuge the sample at 20,000 x g for 5 min at room temperature.
Collect the upper phase and transfer it to a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf® DNA LoBind tube.
Add sodium acetate to achieve a final concentration of 0.3 M.
Add 3.7 μl of glycogen per each 100 μl of the solution.
Add 2.5X volumes of absolute ethanol at –20 °C and incubate for 18 h at –80 °C.
Centrifuge the samples at 20,000 x g for 90 min at 4 °C.
Discard the liquid and wash the pellet with 600 μl of ice-cold 70% ethanol.
Centrifuge at 20,000 x g for 15 min at 4 °C.
Discard the liquid and wash the pellet again with 600 μl of ice-cold 70% ethanol.
Centrifuge the solution at 20,000 x g for 15 minutes at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant.
Dry the pellet without over-drying to avoid low DNA recovery.
Dissolve the dried pellet in 100 μl of TE buffer.
Store the samples at -20 °C until sonication is performed.

Sonicate the samples to achieve a mean DNA fragment size of 300–500 base pairs using Bioruptor® Plus settings: 30 seconds ON, 90 seconds OFF, high mode, for 16 cycles; or use Covaris S-series with duty 10%, intensity 4, time 30 seconds, cycle/burst 200, for 4 cycles in 50 μl TE/water.
Pre-warm AMPure XP beads for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Add 80 μl of AMPure XP bead suspension to each sample.
Mix the samples thoroughly by pipetting up and down 5-6 times.
Incubate the samples for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place the samples on a magnetic stand.
Incubate for 5 min until all the beads have attached to the magnet and the liquid is completely transparent.
Carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 μl per sample of ice-cold 80% ethanol while the samples are attached to the magnetic stand.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Repeat the wash in ice-cold 80% ethanol once.
Air-dry the beads for 5 min at room temperature.
Remove the samples from the magnetic stand.
Resuspend each sample in 10 μl of nuclease-free water.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Place the samples on the magnetic stand.
Incubate for 5 min until all the beads have attached to the magnet.
Transfer 7.5 μl of the cleared solution into a 0.5 ml Eppendorf® DNA LoBind tube.
Measure DNA concentration using the Qubit® dsDNA HS Assay Kit.
Check the DNA fragment size distribution by loading 1 μl of sonicated DNA into an High Sensitivity DNA Kit and running it on Bioanalyzer 2100.
Mix sonicated DNA in a 0.5 ml Eppendorf® DNA LoBind tube to prepare the IVT mix.
Incubate the samples for 14 h at 37 °C in a thermocycler with the lid set at 70 °C.
Add 2U (1 μl) of DNase I to each sample.
Incubate the samples for 15 min at 37 °C.
Transfer each IVT product into a 1.5 ml Eppendorf® DNA LoBind tube.
Bring the volume of each sample up to 30 μl with nuclease-free water.
Add a 1.8 vol./vol. ratio of RNAClean XP beads suspension to the IVT product.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up-down 5-6 times.
Incubate for 10 min at RT.
Place the samples on a magnetic stand.
Incubate for 5 min until all the beads have attached to the magnet and the liquid is completely transparent.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 μl per sample of ice-cold 80% ethanol, while the samples are attached to the magnetic stand.
Incubate for 1–2 min at RT.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Repeat the wash with ethanol 80% two times more.
Airdry the beads for 10 min at RT.
Remove the samples from the magnetic stand.
Resuspend the beads in 7.5 μl of nuclease-free water.
Incubate for 5 min at RT.
Place the sample on the magnetic stand.
Incubate for 5 min until all the beads have attached to the magnet.
Mix 1 μl of RA3 adapter to each sample.
Incubate for 2 min at 70 °C with the lid set at 70 °C in a thermocycler.
Place the samples on ice immediately.
Add 1 μl of T4 RNA Ligase buffer 10X to each sample.
Add 1 μl of T4 RNA Ligase 2, truncated (200 U/μl) to each sample.
Add 1 μl of RNaseOUT™ to each sample.
Incubate the samples for 2 h at 25 °C in a thermocycler with the lid set at 30 °C.
Transfer the samples onto ice.
Incubate the samples for 2 min at 70 °C in a thermocycler with the lid set at 70 °C.
Immediately place the samples on ice.
Add 11.5 μl per sample of reverse transcription mix, including 5 μl of 1st strand buffer, 0.5 μl of dNTPs mix, 2 μl of DTT 100 mM, 2 μl of SuperScript®, and 2 μl of RNaseOUT™.
Incubate the samples for 1 h at 50 °C in a thermocycler.
Transfer each sample into a 200 μl PCR tube.
To each sample, add 4 μl of the desired RPI (10 μM) primer.
Add 71 μl of PCR mix to each sample.
Include 50 μl of NEBNext® 2X PCR Mix in the PCR mix.
Include 4 μl of RP1 primer in the PCR mix.
Include 17 μl of nuclease-free water in the PCR mix.
Incubate samples at 98 °C for 30 seconds.
Incubate samples at 98 °C for 10 seconds.
Incubate samples at 60 °C for 30 seconds.
Incubate samples at 72 °C for 30 seconds.
Repeat steps B through D for 8–14 cycles as needed.
Incubate samples at 72 °C for 10 minutes.
Hold samples at 4 °C.
Prewarm the AMPure XP beads for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer each PCR product into a 1.5 ml Eppendorf® DNA LoBind tube.
Add a 0.8 volume ratio of AMPure XP bead suspension to each sample.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up-down 5-6 times.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Place the samples on a magnetic stand.
Incubate for 5 min until all the beads have attached to the magnet and the liquid is completely transparent.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 μl per sample of ice-cold 80% ethanol while the samples are attached to the magnetic stand.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Repeat the wash in ice-cold 80% ethanol once.
Airdry the beads for 5 min at room temperature.
Remove the samples from the magnetic stand.
Resuspend each sample in 20 μl of nuclease-free water.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Place the samples on the magnetic stand.
Incubate for 5 min until all the beads have attached to the magnet.
For each sample separately, transfer 17–18 μl of the cleared solution into a 1.5 ml Eppendorf® DNA LoBind tube.
Measure DNA concentration using the Qubit® dsDNA HS Assay Kit.
Store the libraries at -20°C.
